invariants.rationale: Context is required for table operations and is almost always expected to be non-null.
The instant time identifies the commit or action time, so should be set.
The method expects a records list to insert/overwrite—passing null would be invalid usage.
It's likely that insert/overwrite should not be called with an empty records list; alternatively, if records is null, this check passes safely.
If instantTime is provided, it is expected to be non-empty to identify the commit/search time.
